about_the_game:
**THIS GAME IS STILL IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT** 

 

Explore the depths of the cathedral on your mission to eradicate the plague in this puzzle adventure game. Make your way towards the final chamber as you uncover the mysteries behind your companion and the cathedral around you. 

Key Features 

  • Explore a byzantine era cathedral which has been corrupted by the plague  

  • Solve light-based puzzles and use the light to cleanse the cathedral  

  • Work together with your companion to overcome obstacles 

  • Reveal the truth behind the plague and your companion 

About the Development Team 

This game is being developed by a team of 15 third-year students at Breda University of Applied Sciences. The game will fully release in June.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card with the latest drivers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Katharsi is a puzzle adventure set in a corrupted Byzantine cathedral. With the help of your companion, cleanse and illuminate the path in front of you by harnessing the power of the light. Solve the puzzles that block your path and reveal the truth behind this story.
